$comment: Digitexa UI registry. `npm run registry` compiles this into public/r/*.json. npm dependencies and `requires` are derived from each file's imports; list extra `requires` here only for things imports can't show.
name: digitexa-ui

items.name: theme
items.description: Tokens (light/dark, 6 accents, density) and the Tailwind v4 mapping.

items.name: utils
items.description: cn(): clsx + tailwind-merge, aware of the kit's font scale.

items.name: use-now
items.description: useNow(): a client-only clock (null on the server) for prerender-safe dates.

items.name: button
items.description: 6 variants, 6 sizes, asChild, never submits by accident.

items.name: input
items.description: 3 sizes, error state via aria-invalid.

items.name: textarea
items.description: Grows with its content.

items.name: label
items.description: Form label that dims with a disabled peer.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: Checked, unchecked and indeterminate.

items.name: switch
items.description: On/off toggle.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: Radio buttons and selectable cards (RadioCard) for visual choices.

items.name: select
items.description: Accessible single select with groups and labels.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: Segmented control with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Segmented or underline tabs.

items.name: badge
items.description: Semantic and work status variants, StatusBadge.

items.name: status-icon
items.description: Status glyphs that show progress: backlog, to do, in progress, review, done.

items.name: avatar
items.description: Image with initials fallback, stable tint per name, AvatarGroup.

items.name: kbd
items.description: Keyboard shortcut hint.

items.name: card
items.description: Card with header/content/footer, plus StatGroup and Stat for key numbers.

items.name: table
items.description: Dense data table with density-aware rows.

items.name: progress
items.description: Thin progress bar with tones.

items.name: meter
items.description: Stacked distribution bar for status breakdowns and workload.

items.name: separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder with a shimmer.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Tooltip with a one-line shorthand.

items.name: popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: Menu with items, checkboxes, radios, shortcuts and submenus.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: App frame: AppShell, Sidebar with groups and items, Topbar.

items.name: command
items.description: Command palette with filtering, groups and full keyboard control; ⌘K hook.

items.name: dialog
items.description: Modal with header/body/footer, 3 sizes, scrolls when tall.

items.name: slider
items.description: Radix slider with one or two thumbs for single values and ranges, labelled per thumb.

items.name: toggle
items.description: Two-state pressable button with default and outline variants, sized like Button.

items.name: field
items.description: Form field layout that wires label, description and error ids to the control.

items.name: input-group
items.description: Input with leading or trailing icons and text addons in one focus-ringed box.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Dependency-free month calendar with single or range selection and full keyboard nav.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: Input-styled trigger that opens a calendar popover; single date and range pickers.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Searchable select on Popover and Command, single or multiple with badge chips.

items.name: alert
items.description: Inline callout in info, success, warning, danger and neutral, with icon, action and dismiss.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog that needs an explicit choice, with a danger action option.

items.name: sheet
items.description: Side panel built on Dialog that slides in from any edge, in four sizes.

items.name: toast
items.description: Dependency-free toasts: call toast(), mount one Toaster; stacks, pauses on hover, promises.

items.name: spinner
items.description: Accessible loading spinner in five sizes that takes the current text color.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: Placeholder for empty views with icon, title, description and actions; dashed variant.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: Popover-styled preview card that opens on hover or focus.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: Right-click menu with the same API and styles as DropdownMenu.

items.name: accordion
items.description: Single or multiple disclosure sections, plain or card style, animated height and chevron.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: Radix Collapsible with a styled chevron trigger and animated content height.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Accessible breadcrumb trail: asChild router links, current page, separators, ellipsis.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Page links with ellipses, usePagination hook, ready-made controls and compact status.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: Radix ScrollArea with thin themed scrollbars, vertical, horizontal or both.

items.name: data-table
items.description: Typed columns, sorting, row selection, filter, column toggle, sticky header, pagination.

items.name: priority
items.description: Linear-style priority bars: urgent, high, medium, low, none, with labels.

items.name: task-row
items.description: List-view task row with status toggle, priority, project, due date; collapsible groups.

items.name: kanban
items.description: Controlled dnd-kit board: drag cards across columns by mouse or keyboard, WIP limits.

items.name: timeline
items.description: Gantt timeline: day/week scale, status bars, milestones, today line, weekend shading.

items.name: calendar-view
items.description: Month calendar for scheduled work: 6-week grid, status pills, +N more popover.

items.name: activity-feed
items.description: Activity feed with avatars, rich sentences, inline statuses and live relative times.
